# explains

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:explains`](gmeow-explains.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/explains>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a candidate hypothesis (a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)) to an explanandum it would account for — the explanatory link a solver back-checks (does the hypothesis, with the background, entail the explanandum?). NOT functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:explains`](gmeow-explains.md) from [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Abduction

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# Winner: influenza — best explains the high fever; promoted to probable.
ex:hypInfluenza a gmeow:StandpointClaim ;
    rdfs:label "Hypothesis: influenza"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:clinician ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propFlu ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:probable ;        # promoted conceivable -> probable (the winner)
    gmeow:explains ex:fever ;                    # solver back-check: would account for the fever
    gmeow:explanatoryScore "0.86"^^xsd:decimal ; # solver-layer (Principle 12)
    gmeow:competesWith ex:hypCold .              # symmetric; irreflexive by SHACL

# Loser: common cold — a weaker explanation of a high fever; SUPPRESSED.
ex:hypCold a gmeow:StandpointClaim ;
    rdfs:label "Hypothesis: common cold (rejected, retained as audit)"@en ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:clinician ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:propCold ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodExpertJudgement ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:conceivable ;      # never promoted
    gmeow:explains ex:fever ;
    gmeow:explanatoryScore "0.41"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:displayable false .                    # Principle 10: suppressed, not erased
```

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- Range is intentionally OPEN (it points at whatever the explanandum is). The back-check is solver-layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
